name: CAMEO1.0 active-learning demonstration software
description: MATLAB autonomous-experiment simulation with Fe-Ga-Pd demonstration data. All four demonstration arrays are byte-for-byte identical to the existing REMI Fe-Ga-Pd corpus; do not add a second dataset/count. Bundled Graph Cut components have their own restrictive notices.

sources.title: NIST CAMEO release
sources.evidence: Downloaded archive includes FeGaPd_CMP,DFT_regions,Mag,XRD; each byte hash matches existing REMI nist-pages source. Current metadata version1.0.1.

name: NIST–NREL Zn–Sn–Ti–O interlaboratory reproducibility study
kind: specialist study and partial data/code release
description: Strong cross-laboratory metrology case study with reported95% agreement intervals of0.1–0.2eV for band gap,24–29nm for thickness and0.08–0.37 orders of magnitude for sheet resistance. Current v1.0.7 archive includes cluster/XRD peak/three-spectrum CSVs and notebooks; full measurement extraction depends on hte.registry.nist.gov. HTEM/HTE source overlap and full-payload accessibility remain unresolved, so it is retained as a resource without an independent corpus count.

sources.title: NIST current primary release
sources.evidence: Old round-robin-data-update.zip returns404; current metadata links a verified8,753,821byte NIST-NREL-Interlaboratory-Figures-master.zip. Notebooks fetch primary records from the HTE registry; included CSVs cover selected analyses.

sources.title: Primary interlaboratory paper
sources.evidence: Explicitly compares two laboratories and different measurement modalities, reporting type-dependent agreement and systematic differences.
